SELECT EMPLOYER_NO, BUSINESS_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, e.MEMBER_NO, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, BUSINESS_TEL, MEMBER_NAME FROM "EMPLOYER" e JOIN "MEMBER" m ON (e.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO) WHERE e.EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo} AND BUSINESS_DEL_FL = 'N'
SELECT BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, bw.WORKTYPE_NO, WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE bw JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON(bw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo}

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, NUM_OF_RECRUITMENT_NAME, RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL, TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE FROM RECRUITMENT WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${empNo} AND RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N'

SELECT e.MEMBER_NO, EMPLOYER_NO, OPTIONAL_AGREE_FL, BUSINESS_REGISTRATION_NUMBER, BUSINESS_NAME, BUSINESS_ADDRESS, BUSINESS_NICKNAME, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NAME, MEMBER_TEL, TO_CHAR(ENROLL_DATE, 'YYYY"년" MM"월" DD"일" HH24"시" MI"분" SS"초"') ENROLL_DATE, m.AUTHORITY_NO, AUTHORITY_NAME FROM "EMPLOYER" e JOIN "MEMBER" m ON(e.MEMBER_NO = m.MEMBER_NO) JOIN AUTHORITY a ON(m.AUTHORITY_NO = a.AUTHORITY_NO) WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND m.AUTHORITY_NO = 1 AND BUSINESS_NICKNAME = '본점' AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo} ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "RECRUITMENT" r JOIN "EMPLOYER" e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}
AND RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )

SELECT RECRUITMENT_NO, RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME,
CASE WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 / 60 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60 * 60) || '초 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 / 24 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24 * 60) || '분 전'
WHEN SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE < 1 THEN FLOOR((SYSDATE - WRITE_DATE) * 24) || '시간 전'
ELSE TO_CHAR(WRITE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') END AS WRITE_DATE,
TO_CHAR(RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS RECRUITMENT_DEADLINE, RECRUIT_COMPLETE_FL FROM RECRUITMENT r JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND r.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo}
AND RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%'
AND ( RECRUITMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' OR e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{query} || '%' )
ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC
SELECT BOARD_NO, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_WRITE_DATE, BOARD_READ_COUNT, BOARD_CODE FROM "BOARD" WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC
SELECT SUBSTR(WORKTYPE_NO, 1, 2) AS "workTypeNo", WORKTYPE_CATEGORY AS "majorCategoryName" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE '__00'
SELECT WORKTYPE_NO AS "workTypeNo", WORKTYPE_CATEGORY AS "worktypeCategory" FROM EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE WHERE WORKTYPE_NO LIKE #{workTypeNo}||'__' AND WORKTYPE_NO NOT LIKE '__00'

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM "BUSINESS_IMG" WHERE EMPLOYER_NO = ${employerNo} ORDER BY BUSINESS_IMG_ORDER

SELECT rr.RECRUITMENT_NO, r1.MEMBER_NO, r1.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, r1.EMPLOYER_NO, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, wp1.PERIOD_NAME, wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, rr.RESUME_NO, r2.RESUME_TITLE, wp2.PERIOD_NAME AS "HOPE_PERIOD_NAME" FROM RECRUITMENT_RESUME rr LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT r1 ON(rr.RECRUITMENT_NO = r1.RECRUITMENT_NO) LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r1.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp1 ON (r1.PERIOD_NO = wp1.PERIOD_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON (r1.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME r2 ON(rr.RESUME_NO = r2.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp2 ON (r2.PERIOD_NO = wp2.PERIOD_NO) WHERE r1.MEMBER_NO = ${memberNo} AND RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL = 'N' AND BUSINESS_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RESUME_DEL_FL = 'N' AND RESUME_HIDE_FL = 'N' ORDER BY RECRUITMENT_NO DESC, EMPLOYER_NO ASC, RESUME_NO DESC

SELECT rr.RECRUITMENT_NO, r1.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, r1.EMPLOYER_NO, r1.RECRUITMENT_DEL_FL, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, e.BUSINESS_DEL_FL, wp1.PERIOD_NAME, wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, rr.RESUME_NO, r2.RESUME_TITLE, r2.RESUME_DEL_FL, r2.RESUME_HIDE_FL, wp2.PERIOD_NAME AS "HOPE_PERIOD_NAME" FROM RECRUITMENT_RESUME rr LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT r1 ON(rr.RECRUITMENT_NO = r1.RECRUITMENT_NO) LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r1.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp1 ON (r1.PERIOD_NO = wp1.PERIOD_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON (r1.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME r2 ON(rr.RESUME_NO = r2.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp2 ON (r2.PERIOD_NO = wp2.PERIOD_NO) WHERE rr.RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo} AND rr.RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT rr.RECRUITMENT_NO, r1.EMPLOYER_NO, r1.RECRUITMENT_TITLE, e.BUSINESS_NICKNAME, e.BUSINESS_TEL, j1.JOBTYPE_NAME, s1.SALARY_NAME, r1.SALARY_MOUNT, wp1.PERIOD_NAME, g1.GRADE_NAME, wd1.DAYS_NAME, wt1.TIME_NAME, wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO, rr.RESUME_NO, r2.WORKER_NO, w.WORKER_MBTI, w.WORKER_ADDRESS, m2.MEMBER_TEL, m2.MEMBER_EMAIL, r2.RESUME_TITLE, s2.SALARY_NAME AS "HOPE_SALARY_NAME", r2.SALARY_AMOUNT AS "HOPE_SALARY_AMOUNT", wp2.PERIOD_NAME AS "HOPE_PERIOD_NAME", g2.GRADE_NAME, r2.RESUME_CONTENT FROM RECRUITMENT_RESUME rr LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT r1 ON(rr.RECRUITMENT_NO = r1.RECRUITMENT_NO) LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(r1.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN JOBTYPE j1 ON(r1.JOBTYPE_NO = j1.JOBTYPE_NO) LEFT JOIN SALARY s1 ON(r1.SALARY_NO = s1.SALARY_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp1 ON (r1.PERIOD_NO = wp1.PERIOD_NO) LEFT JOIN GRADE g1 ON (r1.GRADE_NO = g1.GRADE_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_DAYS wd1 ON(r1.DAYS_NO = wd1.DAYS_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt1 ON(r1.TIME_NO = wt1.TIME_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON (r1.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) LEFT JOIN RESUME r2 ON(rr.RESUME_NO = r2.RESUME_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKER w ON(r2.WORKER_NO = w.WORKER_NO) LEFT JOIN "MEMBER" m2 ON(w.MEMBER_NO = m2.MEMBER_NO) LEFT JOIN SALARY s2 ON(r2.SALARY_NO = s2.SALARY_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_PERIOD wp2 ON (r2.PERIOD_NO = wp2.PERIOD_NO) LEFT JOIN GRADE g2 ON(r2.GRADE_NO = g2.GRADE_NO) WHERE rr.RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo} AND rr.RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT bw.BUSINESS_WORKTYPE_NO, ew.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM BUSINESS_WORKTYPE bw LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON (bw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER e ON(bw.EMPLOYER_NO = e.EMPLOYER_NO) LEFT JOIN RECRUITMENT r ON (e.EMPLOYER_NO = r.EMPLOYER_NO) WHERE RECRUITMENT_NO = ${recruitmentNo}
SELECT j.JOBTYPE_NAME FROM RESUME_JOB_TYPE rjt LEFT JOIN JOBTYPE j ON (rjt.JOBTYPE_NO = j.JOBTYPE_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT rd.RESUME_NO, wd.DAYS_NAME, wt.TIME_NAME FROM RESUME_DAYSTIME rd LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_DAYS wd ON (rd.DAYS_NO = wd.DAYS_NO) LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_TIME wt ON (rd.TIME_NO = wt.TIME_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
SELECT wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_INFO FROM RESUME_ADDRESS ra LEFT JOIN WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE wat ON (ra.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO = wat.WORKCOND_ADDRESS_TYPE_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
SELECT ew.WORKTYPE_CATEGORY FROM RESUME_WORKTYPE rw LEFT JOIN EMPLOYER_WORKTYPE ew ON (rw.WORKTYPE_NO = ew.WORKTYPE_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}

SELECT rc.CAREER_NO, ci.COMPANY_NAME, TO_CHAR(START_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS START_DATE, TO_CHAR(END_DATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS END_DATE FROM RESUME_CAREER rc LEFT JOIN CAREER_INFO ci ON (rc.CAREER_NO = ci.CAREER_NO) WHERE RESUME_NO = ${resumeNo}
